message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_morphological_features_via_direct_image_inspection", "description": "When interpreting chest X-rays for subtle morphological features (e.g., intracystic vessels, lesion boundaries) that are ambiguous or absent in generated reports, prioritize direct visual inspection of the original image pixels over automated summaries.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical imaging interpretation where specific structural details or subtle findings are required for diagnosis but may be omitted or hallucinated by automated reporting tools.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the `chest_xray_report_generator` output lacks specific morphological details (e.g., vessel presence within a cyst, precise boundary definition) or describes them ambiguously: (1) Do NOT rely solely on the generated text summary; (2) Directly inspect the original image pixels to verify the presence and characteristics of the feature; (3) Base the final diagnostic conclusion on the visual evidence from the source image rather than the potentially incomplete report."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
